rows.reason: Season-to-feeling link shown on winter/cold and carried to summer/warm; holiday and August correctly set aside as summer-linked, not a feeling.

Rule stated does not exclude the distractor week: "Many minutes make one hour, a bigger unit. So hours make one day, bigger again." Many hours also make a week, which is bigger again. The script must name the NEXT unit up (60 minutes to an hour, 24 hours to a day) for "Clock and week miss that step in size" to follow.
Part-to-whole shown on leaf/tree and carried to petal/flower; garden and stem correctly rejected as not the whole the petal belongs to.
"Airport and wing sit by planes, steering nothing." describes wing wrongly: a wing is part of a plane, not beside it. Also "A captain steers the ship he leads" assumes a captain is male.
"Farm and grass go with cows, not food." is false for grass: grass is food (the cow's food). The contrast needs to be "not what a cow gives".
"Stable and hay go with horses, not young." is clipped and ungrammatical; a child can read "not young" as describing the horses. Needs e.g. "not with their babies."
"Egg and branch sit by the home, not it." is clipped ("not it") and misdescribes egg, which sits in the nest, not by it.

Fault partly in the question: king:crown is read as "the thing a king is known by" as readily as "worn on the head", and on that reading sword (the knight's emblem) is defensible. Script also ends ungrammatically: "go with knights, not head."
Maker-to-product shown on baker/bread and carried to potter/vase; oven and clay correctly rejected as aids to making, not the thing made.
"Hair and neck sit by the head, covering nothing." is false for hair, which grows on the head and covers it. "A shoe covers the foot warmly" adds a claim the link does not use.
Thing-to-size shown on puddle/small and carried to lake/large; water and little each rejected with a true reason.
Sound-level link shown on whisper/quiet and carried to shout/loud; voice and mouth correctly rejected as speaking, not the sound.
Start-to-grown-form link shown on seed/plant and carried to egg/chick; shell and nestbox correctly rejected as going with eggs.

"Bone and kennel go with dogs, not grown up." is ungrammatical and unclear to a child. The link also shifts wording ("is a young cat" then "grows into a dog"), so the same sentence is not carried across.
Covering link shown on hand/glove and carried to foot/sock; leg and lace correctly rejected as near the foot, not a covering for it.
"Honey and sting come from bees, not homes." reads as "honey does not come from homes", but honey is made in the hive. Misleading description of a wrong option.
Light-giver link shown on day/sun and carried to night/moon; owl and sleep correctly rejected as night-linked but not giving light.
Body-part-to-job link shown on eye/see and carried to ear/hear; sound and head correctly rejected as not the job.
Tool-to-use link shown on pen/write and carried to knife/cut; fork and sharp correctly rejected as not the job.
Animal-to-movement link shown on fish/swim and carried to bird/fly; wing and sky correctly rejected as not the moving.
Vehicle-to-path link shown on car/road and carried to train/track; station and ticket correctly rejected as not paths.
Worker-to-workplace link shown on teacher/school and carried to doctor/hospital; medicine and nurse correctly rejected as not the place.
Weather-to-effect link shown on rain/wet and carried to sun/dry; wet rejected as the first pair's word and yellow as only a colour.
Turns-into link shown on caterpillar/butterfly and carried to tadpole/frog; pond and jump correctly rejected as not the change.
Thing-to-use link shown on book/read and carried to song/sing; music and note correctly rejected as not the doing.
